boundaryPolicy.hashNormalization: UTF-8 text with LF line endings
boundaryPolicy.inclusionRule: Include INSIDE_DANANG and BOUNDARY_EDGE records after point-in-polygon classification.
boundaryPolicy.boundaryEdgeRule: Retain edge points for review; do not reject them solely for numerical boundary contact.
boundaryPolicy.coastalRule: Polygon membership is authoritative; islands, peninsulas, bridges, and coastal POIs are not removed by a simplistic land mask.
boundaryPolicy.acquisitionVsFinal: The acquisition bounding box limits retrieval only; the versioned polygon controls final geographic eligibility.
boundaryPolicy.futureUpdateRule: A new boundary version/hash requires explicit scope review and geography-only reclassification before use.
boundaryPolicy.intendedScopeEvidence: Project context explicitly keeps Hoi An as a separate future City Pack.
boundaryPolicy.approvalMeaning: This policy approves evaluation scope only and does not authorize canonical writes.

blocker: No explicit human APPROVE decisions exist; Stage 4J must not authorize canonical mutation.
proposedStage4k: Controlled canary apply of only a very small explicitly approved subset, after a separate approval.
